properties.displayName: MAS - Manual attestation for Centralized SIEM with integration with other clouds, Integration with IAM, Threat Intelligence
properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Ensure the organization have incident response controls, with integration to other security functions. (Monitoring-IR-144).

metadata.Description:
Centralized SIEM
Unified Incident Response Platform
Integration with IAM
Threat Intelligence Integration
Automated Containment and Remediation
Integration with DevSecOps Pipeline

for more details - refer to Control statement
Centralized SIEM
- Integrates with AWS CloudTrail, Azure Monitor, and Google Cloud Audit Logs
- Provides real-time alerting and correlation of security events across all environments
- Enables automated incident detection based on predefined rules and AI-driven anomaly detection
Unified Incident Response Platform
- Automates initial triage and categorization of incidents
- Facilitates collaboration between security teams across different cloud environments
- Provides standardized playbooks for common incident types
Integration with IAM
- Enables rapid user access revocation across all cloud platforms in case of a suspected compromise
- Provides detailed user activity logs to support forensic investigations
- Triggers automatic access reviews for affected systems post-incident
Threat Intelligence Integration
- Enriches alerts with relevant threat data to provide context and prioritize response efforts
- Enables proactive threat hunting across all cloud environments
- Updates detection rules automatically based on emerging threat information
Automated Containment and Remediation
- Implements automated network segmentation to isolate compromised resources
- Triggers automatic snapshots of affected systems for forensic analysis
- Initiates automated remediation workflows for common incident types
Integration with DevSecOps Pipeline
- Enables rapid patching and updates across all cloud environments in response to vulnerabilities
- Facilitates post-incident security reviews of affected applications and infrastructure
- Triggers automatic security scans of related systems and code repositories
metadata.controlTitle: Ensure the organization have incident response controls, with integration to other security functions.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy
